subject.title: feat(memory): carry source actor context into recall

question: Should OpenClaw accept SourceActor as the public plugin, message-context, and memory attribution contract for this stack, or should the API be renamed or narrowed before release?
rationale: The code path is coherent, but the PR creates plugin-facing context fields and memory supplement parameters that become compatibility and privacy contracts once shipped.

options.title: Approve SourceActor Contract
options.body: Treat this as the memory follow-up after #96738, #96862, and #96863 are settled, then resolve draft workflow state before merge.

options.title: Rename Or Narrow Contract
options.body: Ask for a revised API before release if maintainers want different names, fewer scalar mirrors, or a stricter privacy boundary.

options.title: Pause The Stack
options.body: Keep the PR draft or close later if maintainers decide participant attribution should be structurally persisted before exposing best-effort context.

recommendation.title: Approve SourceActor Contract
recommendation.body: Treat this as the memory follow-up after #96738, #96862, and #96863 are settled, then resolve draft workflow state before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across inbound context, plugin descriptor/tool context, and memory recall surfaces touched by this contract decision.
